name: Samaria
overview: Samaria, the capital city of the northern kingdom of Israel, plays a significant role in Scripture as both a geographical and spiritual setting. Jesus traveled through Samaria on His way to Jerusalem and taught important lessons about compassion, as illustrated by the parable of the Good Samaritan. Despite the tension between Jews and Samaritans, Jesus' ministry intersected with this region, although He initially instructed His disciples to avoid Samaritan cities. The history and identity of Samaria are deeply connected to the broader narrative of God's people and His redemptive plan.
